headline.title: AI-generated actors and scripts are now ineligible for Oscars
headline.summary: The Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences has announced that AI-generated actors and scripts will no longer be eligible for Oscar nominations. This decision impacts projects like Tilly Norwood, which may have relied on AI-generated content.

articles.title: The best AI dictation apps, tested and ranked
articles.summary: A recent evaluation of AI dictation apps highlights their effectiveness for tasks such as email responses, note-taking, and coding via voice commands. The article ranks the top-performing apps based on their functionality and user experience.

articles.title: Musk v. Altman week 1: Elon Musk says he was duped, warns AI could kill us all, and admits that xAI distills OpenAI’s models
articles.summary: In the first week of the trial between Elon Musk and OpenAI, Musk claimed he was misled by CEO Sam Altman and president Greg Brockman regarding his financial contributions to the company. He also expressed concerns about the potential dangers of AI, stating it could pose a threat to humanity.

articles.title: Disneyland Now Uses Face Recognition on Visitors
articles.summary: Disneyland has implemented face recognition technology for visitors to enhance security and streamline entry processes. In related news, the NSA is testing Anthropic’s Mythos Preview for vulnerability assessments, and a Finnish teenager faces charges related to the Scattered Spider hacking incidents.

articles.title: Replit’s Amjad Masad on the Cursor deal, fighting Apple, and why he’d rather not sell
articles.summary: Replit CEO Amjad Masad discussed the company's position amid rumors of rival Cursor's potential $60 billion acquisition by SpaceX, emphasizing his preference to remain independent rather than sell. The conversation took place at TechCrunch's StrictlyVC event in San Francisco, addressing key industry questions about acquisitions and competition.

articles.title: Meta buys robotics startup to bolster its humanoid AI ambitions
articles.summary: Meta has acquired the robotics startup Assured Robot Intelligence to enhance its humanoid AI capabilities. This move aims to strengthen Meta's AI models specifically for robotic applications.
